steps.name: Herman
steps.text: You've been by my side for fifteen years, but you've learned nothing.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: All you've managed to pick up are some unsavory tactics. What a dullard you are.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Dullard? Ahaha... Ahahahaha!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Old man, surely you didn't expect me to be out of moves already!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: This... Could it be the earthquake preceding the eruption?!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Ahaha, come! It's finally here!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Turn into ashes along with this city!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: It's too late now! Even if you take control of the broadcast tower, the people will only start panicking!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: The volcano is about to erupt, but what can you possibly accomplish with that 'data' of yours?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: I control all the escape passages! None of you are going to get away!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: You bloody hypocrites can't save anyone!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Everything will be burnt to nothingness, along with the city!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Doctor, what do we do?!

options: Get all the operators to help with the evacuation, now!
At least get everyone to where it's safe!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Doctor, should we mobilize the entirety of Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Doctor, can you hear me? I've finished analyzing the volcano!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: If we act now, we can still buy more time!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Doctor, we've already determined the underlying cause of the volcano's activity. There's a good possibility that we might be able to stop the eruption!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Everyone, please stay calm and listen closely. If you follow my instructions, we will be able to delay the eruption!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: We can definitely help, if it's really something within our power.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Mhm.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: No, please let us handle this.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Cronin has been plotting this for a long time. His henchmen must be all over the city.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: This is the critical moment. Schwarz, Mister Hellagur, you have your own duties.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: We can leave those things to the others...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But this is our mission.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Ceylon...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Agreed.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: We're Catastrophe Messengers, volcanologists, and Originium researchers. None of us will just sit and watch while peoples' lives are threatened by something predictable.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: What's more, there are people who would use their knowledge to deceive others and line their own pockets. As a Catastrophe Messenger, I can't tolerate seeing people like that!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I've never seen you get this serious before, but I understand. In any case, Mayor, allow us to aid you with the evacuation.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: ...Very well. Schwarz, you should come too.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Ceylon said she can handle this.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Milady, please be careful.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Have we finished deciding? We don't have much time!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Okay! Let's get going right now!

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: We should trust her. Besides, what she said was right. We each have our own duty to fulfill.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Gahahaha! They're just rushing towards death! Even if they manage to buy an hour or two, so what?!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Your daughter is going to get buried along with most of this city, and you won't even be able to find her body...

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Guh...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Sorry, I couldn't control myself.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Don't worry. He's right about the threat this poses. We can't afford to endanger the citizens any longer.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Please lend me your assistance.
